item.title: By: ilyas
item.dc:creator: ilyas
item.description: Comment spamming is almost impossible to stop i feel. To stop comment we need to differentiate good comments against spam comments which i feel is most difficult part. I don`t think any of the scripts can stop spamming, there has to be a dedicated human checking.
